title: PlotBench: a desktop workbench for scientific graphing, petrology, thermobarometry and geochronology
description: PlotBench is a free, open-source desktop application that combines scientific graphing and peak fitting with geochemical diagrams, mineral chemistry, thermobarometry and U-Pb geochronology, without coding. Windows, macOS and Linux installers are attached to each GitHub release. Website: https://plotbench.vercel.app/
